description: Is this act in force (galioja), and which consolidated version (suvestinė redakcija) governed on a given date. Pass on_date to ask about the past (įsigaliojimo data). Name the act with ONE of: `document_id` (the `id` of a search hit; an article id with `#` answers about its act) or `act_number` (the register number `XII-2603`, or a code abbreviation `DK`, `CK`). An act you know only by its title: search_law first and take the id. Validity is a property of the act, not of an article: for an article's wording on a date use read_paragraphs with `on_date`, for what changed use compare_provision_versions.

act_number.description: Alternative to `document_id`: the act's official number as the register writes it, e.g. `XIII-2221`, or a code abbreviation the map knows (`DK`, `CK`, `CPK`). A number, never a title or an article (`DK 58` is the act `DK`; ask the article with read_paragraphs). One of the two is required.
act_number.title: Act Number

document_id.description: The act to test, by the `id` of a search hit. An article id (containing `#`) is accepted and answers about its act, because validity is a property of the act.
document_id.title: Document Id

jurisdiction.description: Which jurisdiction the act belongs to (`LT`). Omit for the account's own.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

on_date.description: The date to test, `YYYY-MM-DD` - what governed THEN rather than now. Omit for today. The parameter is `on_date`: `as_of` and `date` are ignored.
on_date.title: On Date

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.

name: check_validity
title: Is it in force
